APPROVE

The extracted `BypassedCtorFqns` builds the same ordinal-comparer set with the same Scala-type and non-empty `CtorFqn` filters, eagerly, and removing the nested loops and ifs from `BypassableInvariantEntities` drops its cognitive complexity well below 16. I could only review the diff, not build it, so I'm assuming `IsScalaType` has no overloads that would make the `Where(IsScalaType)` method group ambiguous. `System.Linq` is already in scope, since the file's existing `.Any(...)` call uses it.
